text:
Iris (CS): Quick request 
- tenant 'mistral' goes live 07:30 PT. Need a 6-item quickfire runbook for CSMs (prefill, warm pool, jitter, batching hints, streaming fallback, renewal_risk rule). Copy/paste snippets please.
Ben (Solutions): Will do. Short checklist + curl/js + minimal telemetry.
Kara (SRE): Infra checks I own: GET /healthz?tenant=mistral = 200; run 2 prefill probes; enable warm pool 20m; jitter=base100ms+rand(0..150ms); retries=3.
Iris (CS): Note: "prefill per-user <= 700 tokens" and tag samples with env.
Ben (Solutions): Curl prefill:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"tenant":"mistral","samples":["hi","orders"]}'
```
Noel (PM): renewal_risk: HIGH if any -> 7d P95>380ms OR 1h error>1.2% OR negative survey within 48h. MEDIUM if marginal. LOW otherwise. cs-bot DM on HIGH.
Kara (SRE): Streaming fallback: if stream aborts <6s, retry sync generate with header X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync and max_tokens=200. Log fallback_event.
Ben (Solutions): Telemetry sample: {"event":"prefill_probe","tenant":"mistral","account_risk":"low","tokens":40,"latency_ms":120,"survey_sent":false}
Iris (CS): I'll make the one-pager and paste into kickoff email.
cs-bot: Alert created -> will DM @Iris when renewal_risk==HIGH :bell:
